title: I · Symbolic and cognitive
body: Space is represented as discrete symbols and relations. The graph connects shelf, door, table and cup; predicates encode relations that can be queried explicitly.
detail: The three graph arrows and both original predicates are retained.

title: II · Geometric and probabilistic
body: Space becomes metric geometry under uncertainty. The occupancy map, uncertain landmarks and trajectory illustrate the joint estimation of pose and map.
detail: The moving point follows the original map trajectory.

title: III · Learning-based
body: A visual observation is encoded into learned, task-specific features. Separate task outputs illustrate depth prediction and detection.
detail: The original input, feature bars and two output branches remain distinct.

title: IV · Foundation models
body: Image, language and 3D inputs feed a shared pretrained model. Transfer connects that model to depth, caption and 3D outputs.
detail: All three input and all three output connections are preserved.

title: V · World-centered
body: An executable, persistent world state supports planning and action. As the world changes, observation updates that state, closing the interaction loop.
detail: The animation follows observe → update → world state → plan → act → observe on the existing arrows.
